sentences.3.4 Skal vi gå på konsert?: 3.4 Shall we go to a concert?
Viola and Synne meet at a café.
They are going to have coffee.
Good. Nice to see you again.
sentences.I like måte. Jeg vil gjerne ha en kaffe: Likewise. I'd like a coffee with milk, please.
sentences.De kjøper kaffe og sitter og snakker sam: They buy coffee and sit and talk.
sentences.Hva gjør du i fritida?: What do you do in your free time?
I like music, dancing and skiing.
sentences.Jeg liker også musikk og dans, og jeg sp: I like music and dancing too, and I play volleyball. I can't ski.
sentences.Jeg kan lære deg, så kan du lære meg lit: I can teach you, and then you can teach me a little Italian.
sentences.Jeg skal på konsert med to venner i morg: I'm going to a concert with two friends tomorrow. Do you want to come?
sentences.Ja, gjerne! Hvem spiller?: Yes, I'd love to! Who's playing?
sentences.Bra! Jeg liker reggae. Hvor skal konsert: Great! I like reggae. Where is the concert going to be?
In the park in the town centre.
sentences.Viola og Synne drikker kaffe og snakker: Viola and Synne have coffee and talk.
sentences.Synne skal gå på konsert med to venner i: Synne is going to a concert with two friends tomorrow, and Viola wants to come along.
sentences.En reggae-artist skal spille i parken, o: A reggae artist is going to play in the park, and Viola likes reggae.
